Danny the Dino has your Halloween weekend in Houston covered! 🎃🦕

Fri: CityCentre trick-or-treat (5–8 pm, free) or Scream on the Green at Discovery Green (6–9 pm, free)
Sat: Last day of Zoo Boo, then trick-or-treat your street at dusk
Sun: Día de los Muertos at the Children's Museum

What's your little monster dressing up as? 👻

Times can change, so check before you go. Follow @springbranchlittles for kid-friendly plans every week.
